paper: #89 All Five Golden Pairs Are Slices of Four-Dimensional Solids
name: Lesser Golden Cut Snub Dodecahedron L/R

field_definition.note: xi is the only real root of the minimal polynomial in the open isolating interval; the polynomial is irreducible over Q; exact strings are polynomials in xi of degree below 6 with rational coefficients. xi is the real root of xi**3 - 2*xi = phi (the snub dodecahedron's cubic); phi = xi**3 - 2*xi, sqrt5 = 2*xi**3 - 4*xi - 1.

status: new: one of the six DICTO Golden-Regular Cuts (#89 Theorem 2: every face golden or regular), which DICTO named; the lesser one, whose truncated triangles have ratio exactly phi, DICTO added to the DICTO-GTT-Solids; not found in the sources checked (#89 Section 8)
scale_note: the snub dodecahedron as the orbit of (1, y, z) under the 60 rotations of the icosahedron (0, +-1/2, +-phi/2) cyclic, y = 1 + (-2)*xi + (-3)*xi**2 + (2)*xi**3 + (2)*xi**4 - xi**5, z = -1 + xi**2 (edge^2 = 12 + (-16)*xi + (-20)*xi**2 + (16)*xi**3 + (20)*xi**4 + (-12)*xi**5 here, 1.392096353); every corner cut at x = 1/(phi sqrt5) = (5 - sqrt5)/10 of its edges (#89 Theorem 2). Chiral: this file is one hand; the other hand (L/R, one D-number for both, as in the Concordance) is its mirror image (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, z).

published_values.faces_as_published: 80 truncated triangles of ratio phi (original sides long), 12 regular decagons, 60 corner pentagons (#89 Theorem 2)

centre.kind: origin of the frame (= the corner centroid)

unit_volume.note: x -> centre + s (x - centre), s = V^(-1/3) with V the exact volume above; s is symbolic and the corners are decimals (15 places, as elsewhere). Same corner order and faces as above; volume 1.
